reviews.text: We took Boss to Enjoy Can because he couldn't relax when he was left alone at home. With private behavior modification classes, we've achieved a change we didn't expect.

We've been working with Teo and our dog, an Argentinian Mastiff, for three months now, and it's been a real revelation. After working with several trainers, we've learned so much from Teo, especially how to handle and manage real-life, everyday situations.

Teo is a true professional, very dedicated, and it's clear he loves what he does. He's explained everything to us, giving us the tools to improve and, above all, understand the reasons behind each behavior and situation. In these months, we've made significant progress, and we'll continue working together to keep improving.

So, we're very grateful and highly recommend him!

I'm so happy with the work they've done with my dog. When we started, he had some reactions to people that worried me quite a bit, and I didn't always know how to help him or understand what he was feeling.

Since we started the sessions, the change has been incredible. He's much calmer, pays more attention to me, and above all, I've learned to better understand his signals and how to act in each situation.

What I've liked most is that the training hasn't focused solely on teaching him commands, but also on building his confidence, his sense of security, and our communication. We've also always received exercises to continue practicing every day.

I'm so grateful for their patience, dedication, and their approach. Seeing how my dog ​​has progressed and how our relationship has improved has been a wonderful experience. I would definitely recommend this trainer to anyone who wants to better understand their dog and help them overcome their difficulties.

My dog ​​has been attending Enjoy Can's group classes since April. She's very happy to go, and we've seen improvements since day one. She keeps progressing, and I feel more confident every day because I know what I need to do. Thank you so much!

We've been working with Alex for about two months now, and we're thrilled with the progress of our Border Collie, Seven. When we started, we could barely walk him because he barked at every movement and was so over-excited that it made daily life very difficult.

In just two months, the change has been enormous. Now we can go for walks with him and manage situations that were practically impossible before. Alex's hard work, patience, and understanding of dogs are truly remarkable.

Although his personal trainer is Teo, he works extensively with Seven, and it's clear he's genuinely committed to him. Furthermore, he doesn't just work with the dog; he also teaches us how to act and how to better understand what he needs.

We also want to highlight the other trainers in the group classes. They are all incredibly attentive, charming, and always ready to help and teach us how to act in every situation. It's clear there's a very dedicated team that truly enjoys their work.

We are very happy with the results and everything we're learning along the way. Seven has improved tremendously and we're eager to see him continue his development.

100% recommended.

Thanks, Alex, and the whole team, for all your hard work! 🫶

We've been using Enjoy Can for less than a year, and the changes have been incredible. Walks went from being a nightmare to being able to enjoy time with our dogs and understand their issues so we can help them. We still have a lot to learn with Enjoy, and we'll be there for it.

Thank you for making life with our dogs so much easier.

I had a bad experience with my dog ​​and another owner where I live, and since it's a small town, people now talk about my dog ​​as "dangerous" just because he's big. Since then, I've been terrified to take him out alone and would come home crying.
With just one training class, I'm now much more relaxed walking my dog. He listens to me much more, and I have so much better control of the leash.
I'm so grateful to Enjoy Can, and I'm definitely going to continue until I don't feel any stress when I take him out and he can trust that I'll be calm and collected.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We couldn't be happier with Enjoy Can. Since Drako started training, we've noticed a spectacular change, and the best part is the way they work: with professionalism, patience, and so much love for the dogs.

They explain every step, answer all our questions, and teach us how to better understand Drako so we can continue working with him at home. It's clear they're passionate about what they do and that they care about the well-being of every dog.

The change has been so evident that even our neighbors have commented on how much Drako has improved and how calm and obedient he is now. Furthermore, family and friends, seeing the results, have also started bringing their dogs to the group classes, and they're just as delighted.

Without a doubt, it's been one of the best decisions we've made. We wholeheartedly recommend Enjoy Can to anyone who wants to improve their dog's training and strengthen their relationship with their dog. Thank you so much for all your hard work!
Excellent service! The trainer is incredibly dedicated and attentive, truly caring about every dog ​​he works with! Highly recommended. Teo, Alex, and everyone else make an excellent team.

We are thrilled with Enjoy Can and the progress of our puppy, Duke. Their trainers are highly qualified and always use positive reinforcement techniques, which we greatly appreciate. They offer both private and group classes and adapt to each dog's needs. It's clear that their priority is improving understanding and communication between dogs and their families. They also work with puppies, fearful dogs, reactive dogs, and dogs with other specific needs. We wholeheartedly recommend Enjoy Can. 🐾
Excellent professionals. They treat the dogs with care and compassion. Their group classes are dynamic and effective. Contacting them was a great decision.

We enrolled my dog ​​Piloto because he was a very energetic and whirlwind dog. From the very first weeks, we noticed a positive change, and he continues to improve to this day. Most importantly, I'm learning about him too. It's clear this is a company that prioritizes the animal's needs from the very beginning, not just profit. I especially want to thank Olga, who has been my trainer and has often gone to great lengths to find time for us. She's always been willing to help and offer advice. Thanks also to Alex and the rest of the team because the service in the group classes has been exceptional. A top-notch company!

Professional trainers. The classes are very well organized to meet the needs of each dog without neglecting the others. The classes don't end until everyone has applied what they've learned, from the first to the last. I highly recommend it.

Eternally grateful!!!
Loki went through several trainers, and with each one he seemed to improve, but… it was like patching things up because one problem would be solved and another would appear 😓.
With Alex and his team, Loki went from not wanting to go outside (he gave us guidelines to follow from day one), to jumping on scooters, at some people and dogs, to… becoming a completely different dog 🥰. They have helped us, and continue to help us, with this, with the arrival of a new member of the family 👶🏻, with moving…
Anyone who knows the Loki of before and the Loki of now asks me what I've done, and I will always say and recommend: Enjoycan and their group classes.

They are truly people who care about the well-being of dogs 🐶 and that's why they are clear (they say things as they are, whether you like it or not), demanding 💪🏼 and very patient (when, after explaining it several times, we're still doing it wrong 😅).
Thank you Alex, Olga, Rober, Miguel, and the whole team. See you in the group sessions to continue helping Loki overcome his fears and insecurities 💪🏼

I absolutely cannot recommend this place, and not because they don't help dogs. Jorge, the trainer, is an incredible person, and he helped our dog tremendously. It was a few months of intense learning for our dog, which was very beneficial, and that's what I take away from it. But that's where the positives end. My dog ​​suffered an injury that left him unable to walk, go for walks, or even do turns... a very long recovery that took months. After explaining why we wouldn't be able to continue with the classes for a while, the owner only asked about our dog once in three months. Then he removed us from the group and never contacted us again (he did keep the money we had already paid for half the month, but I won't even go into that).

It's a shame because they have excellent trainers and the dogs really do learn, but the owner's behavior shows he's only interested in money. If anything happens to your dog, he'll just turn you away and move on to the next client without a second thought. If they advertise their care for the well-being of the dogs, they should show a little more empathy.
I don't mind receiving an aggressive response like the ones he gives to all the bad reviews; I believe in giving constructive criticism.

We took Koda to Enjoy Can because he barked excessively and became very nervous around visitors. With the private behavior modification classes, we've noticed a huge change. They were very professional and attentive throughout the entire process.

Our dog Mia had separation anxiety and would bark for hours whenever we left the house. At Enjoy Can, we worked with her through private behavior modification classes, and the results have been much better than we expected. They offer personalized attention, constant follow-up, and highly professional staff.

We took Nala to Enjoy Can because she would bark at every dog ​​she saw. With their private behavior modification classes, we've been able to walk her much more calmly. They are very professional and friendly.

We arrived at Enjoycan in September when our Kora was about six months old. We had already been with another trainer who had given us guidelines such as not looking at her, not touching her, and waiting for socialization and scent work because she wasn't ready. After two months with him, during which Kora did everything but improve, we decided to leave him and contacted Enjoycan, very wary of dog trainers in general.

We started with group sessions, but it's true that we soon moved to individual sessions because Kora needed it, and we were completely confused about how to handle her. So we started with Teo.

We truly couldn't be more grateful. Kora was very reactive and very, very fearful; she didn't know how to switch off and had no calm moments at home. When we went out, she would automatically bite her leash, bark, and zoom around. All of this, combined with separation anxiety and a great fear of noises, contributed to her condition. Now we have a well-regulated dog, one we know no longer lives in a constant state of anxiety, and therefore, neither do we. She's capable of things we never imagined before, and she's much less reactive, socializes wonderfully, and can lie down immediately when she gets home.

We still have a lot of work to do, such as addressing fears and separation anxiety, as it's ongoing work that requires time. But we've improved a lot, and above all, we have a very clear structure to follow.

Teo has been a pillar of support these past months and has become a friend to us and Kora, who adores him. Lately, Kora has progressed so much that we've gone back to group training and now only have one individual session a month to reinforce everything we've worked on and address any questions that arise. Just as we previously felt Kora wasn't ready for group training, now she is, and it's been fantastic for her.

If you're unsure which company to use to train your dog, I encourage you to prioritize one that focuses on self-control and emotional regulation, and Enjoycan are experts in this.

Getting to this point with Kora has involved, and continues to involve, daily work with her at home and prioritizing her well-being and her rhythm above almost everything else. It's not just the training session; it's the consistency you maintain afterward. It's a very tiring and overwhelming process, but there's nothing like seeing her so calm and stable, and being able to enjoy it together.

Many thanks to Teo, Álex, and the entire Enjoycan team, truly ❤️

Enjoy Can is my last hope. I've been training with them all summer and I'm seeing improvements in my dog. At least one day during a walk in my neighborhood, he didn't bark at a single other dog. Ultimately, training isn't magic; it's about consistency and patience. You can't expect a dog to change in two days; you have to work at it. I really like how they conduct their classes.
The class is very dynamic and you can see the affection and commitment to the dogs from the Enjoycan team.

Without a doubt, the best!! They've helped us with every single problem Thor, our dog, has had. The group classes are fantastic, and you learn so much about dogs, not just your own. The team is unbeatable. In just a few months, both we and our little one have seen a huge improvement in our quality of life. A 10 out of 10, guys!!! ❤️

Enjoy Can is like a family! They listen to you, help you, and teach you how to support and understand your dog, as well as how to understand canine communication.

A very special thank you to Teo for all the private and group lessons, where he helped Isidro gain confidence and learn to interact with other dogs. Isidro has improved tremendously, but I'm the one who has learned the most. Thank you for everything!

I've been taking my dog ​​Bimba for about a month now and I'm very happy. The experience is fantastic, both for her and for me. You learn to understand your dog and how to communicate with your loyal companion.

We decided to go with EnjoyCan because of our dog Zazú's fears, reactivity, and resource guarding. We've only had two group classes, and we're quite happy with them (although still a little lost, getting our bearings so we can really get started and practice what we learn at home). Besides the obvious professionalism and knowledge they have, you can see they're genuinely interested and dedicated to helping the dogs. The classes really fly by!

We've only had a few sessions, but we're really happy. It's a fun activity for both dogs and owners, and it definitely helps you understand your dog better and improves your relationship.

Alex and the whole team are very friendly and always willing to help with any questions. You can tell they love what they do.

I definitely think it's a worthwhile investment, both for the happiness of the dog and the owners. Looking forward to learning more!

We couldn't be happier with Enjoy Can. Alicia, Olga, Teo, and especially Alex have done an incredible job with our dog.

I want to give special mention to Alex because the way he reads dogs and understands their needs is amazing. You can tell he truly loves them and enjoys what he does. His patient and caring approach makes you completely trust him.

Our poodle was very nervous. Walks were a constant source of stress: he pulled on the leash a lot, barked at everything, and it was impossible to enjoy a peaceful stroll. We thought there were things we'd never be able to do with him, and yet, this summer we're enjoying him immensely. Now we can walk peacefully, sit on a terrace with him, and make plans that were previously unthinkable.

Obviously, you have to be involved and work at home, but with their help, the change has been enormous. We can only thank them from the bottom of our hearts and recommend them wholeheartedly. Thanks to the whole Enjoycan team for helping us understand our dog much better and enjoy him like never before 💛🐶

We've been training with Alex and his team every week for over a year now, learning to understand our dog's behavior and energy levels. The change we've all undergone is incredible. She's become a confident and controlled dog, and we've learned to read her and trust her, without fear and with great confidence. Recently, when our second dog arrived, we didn't hesitate to enroll him too, and in just a few months, we've already noticed him losing his fears and our relationship improving. The classes are so much fun, and it's wonderful to see how involved they are with all the dogs. You can tell they work with genuine love for them and that their well-being and stability will always be their top priority. THANK YOU 💛💛

We've been going to group classes with our greyhound for over seven months now. It's truly wonderful; you learn so much about understanding your dog and helping them enjoy themselves while avoiding anxiety. The atmosphere and the people are very friendly, and the trainers are very professional. I'm absolutely delighted with them, both for how much they teach me and how kind they are.

We've been with them since we got our dog Gotham, and it truly couldn't have been a better decision. They've helped us understand him and how to handle everyday situations. They specialize in potentially dangerous breeds (PPP), and ours is one, so I highly recommend them.

We recently started training with ENJOY CAN and we're thrilled. From the beginning, Alex explains everything very clearly and doesn't try to sell you anything unrealistic. We came from another trainer where my dog ​​didn't improve at all, but after only a short time with ENJOY CAN and following Alex's instructions, we've already started to see changes in my potentially dangerous breed.
I wholeheartedly recommend ENJOY CAN and Alex and his team.

We adopted a puppy in April and knew from the start that we wanted to help him become a well-balanced puppy and, of course, be there for him every step of the way. We knew Alex and his team through some friends and it was a great choice! All three of us are thrilled!

In the months we've worked with Teo and our two dogs, we've found him to be an excellent professional who loves his work and has endless patience with both dogs and families. We highly recommend working with him; we've had incredibly positive results with both dogs, who have very different and complex personalities. We're delighted with how he manages the classes—it's been a real success. A million thanks, Teo!

We took Boss to Enjoy Can because he was having problems with aggression towards other dogs during walks. We started with private behavior modification classes and the change has been incredible. Now we enjoy walks much more and know how to handle each situation. A very professional and friendly team.
We are extremely grateful to Enjoy Can and Vane for the treatment we received and the help they gave us with our dog!
Very happy with Teo. Very satisfied with the training. The follow-up and the learning were incredible. Thank you so much, Teo. See you in the group classes!

We took Nico to Enjoy Can because he couldn't stay home alone without barking. After just a few private behavior modification sessions, we started noticing changes. They're very professional and friendly. Highly recommended!
Alex is a top-notch professional; my experience, although short at the moment, is enough to give A Enjoy Can a positive review.

We went to Enjoy Can with Bruno because he couldn't be left alone at home for even a few minutes without barking and destroying things. After several private behavior modification sessions, we understood what was happening and how to work with him effectively. The change has been gradual but very noticeable. Now he can be left alone much more calmly, and so can we. A very professional and dedicated team.

We took Kira to Enjoy Can because she barked constantly whenever she encountered other dogs, and every walk had become a very stressful experience. We started with private behavior modification classes, and the progress has been incredible. They explained everything very clearly and tailored it to our specific situation. Today, we enjoy walks much more, and Kira is much more balanced. Highly recommended.

After taking my dog ​​to this company for a year, my conclusion is that I wouldn't recommend it for treating reactivity problems.

We went there because our dog reacted to other dogs and people. For months, we followed all the guidelines they gave us, first in private lessons and then in group classes in Vicálvaro. However, the work was mainly based on maintaining distance, avoiding situations, and seeking calm, but we never saw any real improvement in the problem that brought us there.

The group classes were always held separately from other dogs, with no real interaction between them. We learned to manage certain situations better and avoid conflicts, but our dog continued to react when it wasn't possible to maintain distance or avoid the stimulus.

They had some good trainers like Teo and Jorge, but the method doesn't work for reactivity. You don't need years to have a dog that isn't reactive. In a week, and with a little work on your own afterward, you can achieve it. I've seen it and experienced it firsthand.

What finally convinced me I needed a different approach was realizing that, after a year of working with no significant results, just one week with another professional specializing in real-life dog interaction was enough to see enormous changes. Now we can walk in places we previously avoided, sit on patios, and let other people approach her without any problem.

This is just my personal experience, but after investing a year of time, effort, and money without resolving the issue we initially sought help for, I wouldn't hire their services again.
Thank you, Luisa, for always being so patient and smiling with us and Milu. We were so happy with everything you did for her; I'm sure she'll miss you. Especially the food! 😂 …
Thank you so much!! Lula has learned so much!! Luisa is a very good professional!! Thank you for everything!!!!

We turned to Enjoy Can because our dog was experiencing severe anxiety after Christmas when going outside. Our trainer, Luisa, has been wonderful throughout, encouraging us, explaining the process, and providing exercises to work with our dog. It's been a fantastic experience. We are so grateful for all the interest, support, and encouragement she's given us. Enjoy Can is one of the best decisions we could have made in understanding our dog's behavior and the tools they provide to help us improve it. We will be eternally grateful for everything.
Teo is a very good professional. Our dog has learned a great deal from him.

We want to express our gratitude to EnjoyCan for the work they've done with our dog.
We arrived completely desperate because taking him out had become a nightmare, causing us both fear and insecurity.
They not only work with our dog but also with us, teaching us to understand him, read his signals, and manage situations that previously overwhelmed us completely.
Walks are no longer a problem and have become moments we truly enjoy. Highly recommended for anyone going through a similar situation.

I am very happy with the service they offer and they are helping me a lot. I am very grateful to the whole team for their help and advice at all times. Little by little, we are achieving satisfactory progress both as a group and individually.

They're helping me with Giulietta and I'm seeing improvement. There's still a lot of work to do, but I'm happy with everything I've learned and everything they're teaching me! Not just with her, but with me too (they've sorted out a bit of my mental state, haha); they've taught me how she thinks so I can anticipate her needs. We're creating a beautiful bond.

And Giuli, even more so, goes crazy every time she sees Olga!

"I couldn't be more grateful to the entire team. We started this journey with Marcelo attending individual classes with Teo, who was an incredible support and gave us the necessary foundation to understand what was happening with our dog. After that initial work, we moved on to group classes with the rest of the instructors, with Alex leading the way and coordinating the entire process flawlessly. Marcelo's progress has been spectacular: we've gone from having serious reactivity issues with people and other dogs to noticing a remarkable improvement in our daily walks. It's clear they love what they do and that they have a methodology that truly works. It's a highly recommended place for anyone who needs help with their companion's behavior."

Excellent team of trainers!!
We started training Paquito when he was 3 months old and we continue to happily attend each and every one of his classes, seeing a clear and fantastic improvement in our little one. Special mention goes to the professionalism of Teo and all his trainers.

Less than a year ago, we adopted Simba, an adult dog who had spent time living on the streets and in shelters, with all the trauma that often comes with that. We're attending group classes, and they've helped us tremendously to understand our dog, as we knew very little about his past. Our walks have improved significantly, and the connection we've built with him has deepened thanks to the tools the classes have provided. We continue working to improve every day 💪🏽
We've been with them for a month and have noticed a huge difference with our little one! We're so grateful for the care we've received, both for the dog and for us (her owners). Highly recommended!

You can tell they love dogs, as if they were their own. My dogs, Ivy and Ayron, have been taking classes with him for about two or three months now, and they've really improved a lot. Thank you for what you do, not only for my dogs but for all the dogs you work with. I recommend him 100%.

If you're looking for a place where your dog will truly learn and enjoy the process, this training website is an excellent option. They offer both individual and group classes, adapting to the specific needs of each dog and owner.

What stands out most is the friendly and professional approach. From the very first moment, it's clear that the trainers are experienced and, above all, passionate about what they do. They use respectful and effective methods, which generate visible results quickly without causing stress to the animals.

Individual classes are perfect if you need to work on specific issues or progress at your own pace, while group classes are ideal for improving socialization and learning in a dynamic environment. Furthermore, the atmosphere is very positive, making both dogs and their owners feel comfortable and motivated. They also have WhatsApp groups where you can ask any questions you may have at any time, and they will answer them and provide daily guidance.

In short, it's a very comprehensive service, highly recommended for both puppies and adult dogs. Undoubtedly, a great investment to improve coexistence and strengthen the bond with your pet.
Super dynamic group classes with different themes so that dogs can learn in different environments and interact with different dogs :)

My dog's name is Tom, he's a Mastiff. We've been working with the Enjoycan team since the beginning of the year, and it's definitely been a great decision. My dog ​​was quite reactive with other dogs and with certain handling techniques, as he was an adopted dog and had several behavioral issues that needed addressing. At home, the only person who could handle him was my father. Now, I'm able to walk him and take him out on my own, which was unthinkable before. From the start, we've felt very supported by our trainer, Patri, and in the group sessions by Alex and the rest of the team.
The change our dog has undergone in these months has been incredible, and we're very happy and grateful. You can see how they take the time to personalize the approach to each animal's needs and don't give you standardized guidelines; they adapt them to each individual animal and their specific requirements.
I found out about them by seeing the progress of another dog, and their dedication is truly evident. And the best part is how they show you how far you can go with your dog using positive reinforcement; the bond you create is incredible.

I have a one-year-old dachshund with behavioral problems, and we had already worked with two trainers. With Patricia, it's amazing how much she's improved in just three sessions. Before, she wouldn't stay still for a minute, and now I can watch TV and she falls asleep next to me, completely calm.

We've been going to Enjoy Can for several months now, and every day we go to the classes we come back happier. The best part is that they teach us to understand our dogs so we can help them as best as possible. Having a dog is a huge responsibility, but the bond you create with them when they're doing well is wonderful. All thanks to their great team, which keeps growing with fantastic new members!
We will always be grateful.
Ross and Mari ❤️❤️❤️🐶🐶🐶
I'm very happy with the whole Enjoy Can team; they've been very patient with me and my dog ​​Balto and have helped me every step of the way.

Our experience with Enjoy Can has been perfect! Patri is a wonderful teacher for Zoc, and not only is he learning, but we are too. It's great to give dogs this gift so they can be as happy as possible 🐶💕 …

I'm taking my Australian Shepherd puppy to the group classes and we're learning so much; choosing them was a great decision. Plus, the classes are also on weekdays, which makes it much easier to plan.
I highly recommend it! Since we started attending group classes, Gia, our greyhound puppy, obeys us and we can let her off-leash without worry. Thank you for your patience and advice.

After a year working with Alex, Teo, and the rest of the team, we have nothing but good things to say. They understood my dog ​​from day one, respecting his pace and personality. In just one year, his improvement has been incredible, and we continue to work hand in hand with the best every day. Thank you so much!

We went to two trainers without results, and then I found EnjoyCan and finally I'm seeing them! Every day he's getting a little better, and they have a variety of super useful group activities in addition to the individual classes, which in my case have been with Patri, to whom I'm very grateful for all the advice and changes she suggested. Highly recommended!!! Thank you!!!!

Being with Enjoy Can and their amazing team of professionals has been life-changing for both Choco and us. We've forged a much stronger bond and resolved issues like resource guarding and reactivity stemming from fears and insecurities. A huge thank you to Alex and his entire team; they are truly professionals and strive every day to help us achieve the best results. We will continue working with them to keep growing alongside our dog!

We are so happy and grateful for the training we received and for Teo, who was an incredible professional. Anyone wanting to start training their dog should definitely contact them. A million thanks from us and Shyro 😃 …

We took our dog Khaleesi to Enjoy Can SL and we couldn't be happier with the results. From the very first moment, they demonstrated great professionalism, empathy, and a very personal touch, both with us and with her. They understood her personality and adapted the sessions to work on obedience, recall, and anxiety control, achieving visible improvements in a very short time.

In addition, the group classes are wonderful: a fantastic opportunity to socialize dogs in a controlled environment, learn from other cases, and reinforce everything worked on in the individual sessions. They explain everything clearly, teach you how to continue the work at home, and are always available to answer questions.

A committed, passionate, and very humane team. 100% recommended if you're looking for dog training based on respect, consistency, and the dog's well-being. I'm thrilled, and my Khaleesi is even more so!

Now, with the mini-classes, my Khaleesi is very happy! The change is very noticeable and he learns very well (there is also work on our part the rest of the week, because involvement on your part is needed to achieve changes).

ALL I CAN SAY IS THANK YOU.

When Thor (a Malinois mix) entered adolescence, things started to get complicated. He would run away, react negatively to other dogs, and eat things off the ground. Walks went from being great to a nightmare. I counted the minutes until I could get home.
I discovered Enjoy Can online and decided to ask for information. From the very first moment, Alex explained everything clearly. He was honest and didn't give me false expectations, always making it clear that 50% of the work depended on me.

I had no idea about this topic, but I trusted what Alex told me and started Thor's training with individual lessons.

Three months later, the relationship with my dog ​​couldn't be better. The hours fly by on walks.

Now I'm starting group classes, and I couldn't be happier.

I know that without their help, I couldn't have achieved any of this.

Thank you, Alex and Teo, for your professionalism and your kindness.

I've been with them for over 3 years now and Yako and I continue to learn every time we go to classes. We've always received amazing treatment from the whole Enjoy Can team. I'll continue with them for a long time; it's a pleasure to learn with them.

From my personal experience, I think it was a great decision to take our dog to the group classes with Alex and the others. From the very first moment, everything started to change, and most importantly, it was always a positive experience. You and your dog both learn. I highly recommend it.

From day one at ENJOY can, it's been wonderful. They've not only taught Rosqui to gradually improve his behavior, but they've also helped us understand him better.
The treatment is friendly, professional, and always respectful of the dogs. You can tell they love what they do.
We wholeheartedly recommend their classes to anyone who wants to put themselves in the hands of professionals to help their companion with respect and love. Thank you for helping us so much!

Alex and the team of trainers are very professional, including their master dogs. I started seeing results in my dog ​​Gus after just two sessions. He's now less insecure and reactive, walks calmly, and gets along much better with other dogs. I highly recommend them!

I've been working with Dobby since he was 4 months old.
We started with Teo as a private dog trainer, and now that Dobby is about to turn two, we're continuing with them.
We've been training in groups for about a year and a half.
My wife and I have come to consider it a hobby, not only because Alex's method is incredibly helpful, but also because we love learning. Alex might seem serious and stubborn at first (and sometimes he is), but if you show that you're truly willing to work, he'll treat you like family.

Whenever something tough has happened to us, EnjoyCan has been there, and Alex in particular, to try and cheer us up.

Dobby is a pretty stable dog, with some fears, but everything he is today is thanks to EnjoyCan. The best example is that Dobby could be a very aggressive dog due to his fears and much more insecure than he is, since that's how his siblings are, the ones they haven't worked with, and he's the complete opposite.

For me, Alex, Teo, Olga, and EnjoyCan are family, because they don't just focus on helping your dog, they help strengthen your bond, and that's something you can't find anywhere else.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart. We will never have enough words to express our gratitude.
We've had two group classes with our Westie puppy. They're fun classes, and each day they cover different things. Since they're in groups of ten, the dogs learn how to behave with other dogs.

The team at Enjoy Can is extraordinary; you can tell they love what they do, and they teach us how to read and understand dogs. Kinder is gradually losing his fears and insecurities. I would recommend them to any friend.

I've been attending group classes with my dog, Sapito, for two months now. We found him abandoned a year ago; we don't know how old he is or anything about his past. Forget about putting him around any other dog, and he was also very fearful of everyone except us. We decided to sign him up for group classes, and we saw improvement from the very first session. In fact, after that class, we went for a walk, and he ended up playing with two other dogs… I couldn't believe it!

However, you obviously have to put them into practice at home until the next session (just like with any other training company or private trainer). I 100% recommend group classes!
